text:
Lord Jesus Christ, who said to your Apostles, “I leave peace with you; I give you my peace”: do not regard our sins, but the faith of your Church; and according to your will, be pleased to grant her peace and bring her together in unity. You who live and reign for ever and ever.

Amen.
